default.title: Help
default.overview: Navigate to a page using the sidebar to see context-sensitive help for that section.

apiReference.heading: API Reference
apiReference.text: Visit the API Docs page for a full interactive reference of all endpoints.

dashboard.title: Dashboard
dashboard.overview: A live health snapshot of your state management infrastructure.

quickLinks.heading: Quick Links
quickLinks.text: Common admin actions — manage users, create API keys, configure sources — are one click away from the Quick Links panel.

users.title: Users
users.overview: Manage user accounts. Users can be created manually or created automatically on first OIDC login. Assign users to organizations and grant them role templates here.

createUser.heading: Create User
createUser.text: Click "Add User" to create a new account with an email and display name.

editUser.heading: Edit User
editUser.text: Click the edit icon on any row to update the user's name, organization, or role.

deleteUser.heading: Delete User
deleteUser.text: Removes the user account. Any API keys they hold will also be invalidated.

organizations.title: Organizations
organizations.overview: Organizations are namespace containers. Members of an organization inherit its role template's permissions.

createOrganization.heading: Create Organization
createOrganization.text: Click "Add Organization" to define a new namespace with a URL-safe name.

manageMembers.heading: Manage Members
manageMembers.text: Expand an organization row to view and modify its member list.

deleteOrganization.heading: Delete Organization
deleteOrganization.text: Only possible when the organization has no associated resources.

roles.title: Roles & Permissions
roles.overview: This page shows the fixed role templates available. Role templates define the permission scopes granted to users within an organization. Templates are system-defined and read-only.

viewScopes.heading: View Scopes
viewScopes.text: Expand a role template to see the full list of permission scopes it grants.

assignToUser.heading: Assign to User
assignToUser.text: Go to Admin → Users to assign a role template to a user's organization membership.

oidcGroups.title: OIDC Groups
oidcGroups.overview: Maps identity provider group claims to organizations and roles. When a user logs in via OIDC, their group memberships are read from the ID token and used to automatically provision or update their organization membership.

groupClaimName.heading: Group Claim Name
groupClaimName.text: Set this to the claim key in your OIDC ID token that carries the user's group list (e.g. "groups").

defaultRole.heading: Default Role
defaultRole.text: Optionally assign a fallback role to users whose groups do not match any mapping.

addMapping.heading: Add a Mapping
addMapping.text: Click "Add Mapping" to link an IdP group name to an organization and role template.

saveChanges.heading: Save Changes
saveChanges.text: Click "Save Changes" to persist your group claim and mapping configuration.

apiKeys.title: API Keys
apiKeys.overview: API keys allow programmatic access to authenticated endpoints. Each key is shown once at creation and stored only as a bcrypt hash — it cannot be retrieved after creation.

createKey.heading: Create Key
createKey.text: Click "Create API Key" to generate a new key. Copy it immediately — it will not be shown again.

revokeKey.heading: Revoke Key
revokeKey.text: Delete a key to immediately invalidate all requests using it.

useKey.heading: Use the Key
useKey.text: Include the key as Authorization: Bearer <key> in HTTP requests.

errorBoundary.title: Something went wrong
